headline: Apple’s new AirTags are back down to their best price
summary: Apple AirTags are currently at their all-time low price point. A four-pack is available for $89 ($10 off) at Amazon and Target. Costco members can also find this discounted bundle.

headline: Google Earth's AI deepfake tool only lasted one day
summary: Google swiftly shut down a new AI feature in Google Earth after just one day. The tool allowed users to generate AI deepfakes of real-world satellite images. Concerns arose from users creating controversial images, leading to its removal.

headline: The NHTSA is investigating 1.2 million Tesla vehicles over suspension failure reports
summary: The NHTSA is investigating nearly 1.2 million Tesla vehicles due to suspension failure complaints. Reports indicate a potential "loss of vehicle directional control." The probe targets 2018-2020 Model 3 and 2021-2023 Model Y cars.

headline: Google might launch a ‘Pixel Tag’
summary: Google appears to be developing its own item tracker, potentially named 'Google Pixel Tag'. An image and store listing suggest an oval-shaped device with a built-in speaker. This new gadget would likely compete with Apple's AirTag.

headline: The $500 Console Is Dead
summary: Gaming hardware prices have soared, making new consoles more expensive than ever. The era of the affordable $500 console appears to be permanently over. Consumers face challenges when trying to purchase new gaming systems or PCs.

headline: Get a Dual 15" 1080p Portable USB Monitor Setup to Boost Your Producitivity for Just $82.99
summary: A dual 15-inch 1080p portable USB monitor setup is available for only $82.99. This Amazon Lightning deal includes a significant $117 off coupon code. The offer is expected to sell out quickly.

headline: The 4K-Ready iBuypower AMD Ryzen 9 9900X Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming PC Drops to $1,799
summary: A powerful iBuypower gaming PC with AMD Ryzen 9 and Radeon RX 9070 XT is now priced at $1,799. This prebuilt system is capable of running the latest games in 4K resolution. It's ideal for titles like Pragmata, 007: First Light, and Forza Horizon 6.

headline: Booster Gold TV Show Writer Says His DC Series 'Won't Be Moving Forward'
summary: Writer David Jenkins confirmed his Booster Gold TV show will not be progressing. This news follows actor Mahershala Ali's departure from Marvel's Blade project. It's a disappointing blow for fans of DC superhero adaptations.

headline: Spain's PM blames traffickers after 60,000 migrants reach Ceuta from Morocco
summary: Spain's Prime Minister attributes the arrival of 60,000 migrants in Ceuta to human traffickers. Most migrants reportedly returned to Morocco by Friday evening. Italy has suspended its Schengen agreement with Madrid in response.

headline: Watch: Moroccan police clash with migrants near border with Spain's Ceuta
summary: Moroccan police have clashed with migrants near the border of Spain's Ceuta territory. Thousands of migrants attempted to cross into Ceuta from Morocco. Officials confirm over 25,000 migrants have voluntarily returned.

headline: Fifa executive says staff 'deceived' by Infantino plans
summary: Fifa's chief operating officer heavily criticized Gianni Infantino's recent plans. The COO stated that staff felt 'deceived' by Infantino's proposals. The controversial plans involve selling stakes in Fifa competitions to private investors.

headline: No sentence long enough for jailed funeral director Robert Bush, say families
summary: Families expressed strong reactions to the 20-year sentence given to funeral director Robert Bush. Victims' families feel the sentence is inadequate for the severity of his crimes. The article highlights the ongoing emotional impact on those affected.
